headline: Reviews split on how notable the new M6 MacBook Pro is
summary: Both reviews cover Apple's 14-inch MacBook Pro with its new M6 chip. Engadget calls the update only a slight upgrade and more of the same, while Tom's Hardware frames the speedy new M6 chip and N1 Wi-Fi 7 chip more positively.

claims.statement: Both reviews cover the 14-inch MacBook Pro with Apple's new M6 chip.
Engadget frames the update as only a slight, incremental upgrade.

The M6 MacBook Pro is more of the same, but that's still pretty great.
